# Member-first experience and source audit — November 7, 2026

## Scope and decision

The monk requested a self-audit, a simple House/Senate landing page, expandable documents, independent content review, an Epstein workstream and reusable researcher procedures. Decision: implement a static, source-linked member experience; preserve existing owner-private audience and closed confidential intake. No live agent/API, credentials, official investigation, witness contact, referral or institutional adoption is authorized by a public task card.

## Evidence-first review

Canonical WSP 97 and WSP 00 workflow were retrieved from FOUNDUPS/Foundups-Agent at commit `152d52dd92088728340fbcb17fe80c4bdf63a732`. Existing source/test inventory and WRE/RedDog work-order references were read before this slice. WSP 00 bootstrap was attempted and failed because torch is absent. Semantic HoloIndex freshness and WRE admission are not established in this detached research environment. No repository-bound WSP validator compliance, runtime state, independent provider diversity or RSI claim is made. The available reference copies and connector reads are research context, not runtime admission.

Reasoning decision: a member first needs institutional roles and next actions, then supporting detail. Put one wheel and three actions before the full manual. Do not merge House/Senate compulsory powers or treat AGs/DAs as subordinate spokes. Reject a blocking poll that presupposes criminal guilt; provide optional source-linked oversight questions instead. Do not add a competing autonomous scheduler: preserve the existing FoundUps work-order/lease/verification ownership in the future integration contract.

## Findings and resolutions

| Finding | Resolution | Evidence / limit |
|---|---|---|
| House-centric introduction hid Senate powers | Visible Senate spoke, standalone route and member guide | Rules XXV–XXVI and separate Senate enforcement approvals; 120th procedures still require recheck |
| Wheel risked appearing to grant authority | Hub labeled professional support; independent state link labeled lawful referral/no command | Focused legal reviewer checked actual new text and diagram wording |
| Current roadmap retained obsolete local completion marks | Reconciled current feature/status text; historical receipts remain clearly dated | Source roadmap now uses prepared-document links |
| BSA summary omitted specific purpose classes | Corrected §1010.950(c) description | Particular information desired, criminal/tax/regulatory purpose and official need; discretion/recheck retained |
| Proposed State Department destination was wrong | Added DOJ/state AG/DA bill comparison | Enacted Pub.L.119-38 distinct from H.R.9694/S.5005 introduced versions; full later action history inaccessible |
| “Vetted” could overstate sampled AI review | Review manifest lists each of 24 drafts, exact bytes, scope and human-review pending | Collaborating agents share a system; no professional signoff |
| Queue source gate accepted private/credential URLs | Reused public-source validator and tested private, credential, malformed-port cases | Syntax protection is not DNS/redirect isolation; no source-fetch service exists |
| Route test expected retired heading | Updated assertion and tested inherited property routes | Own-property/function guards retained; no weakening of routing |
| Shared explorer loading coupled unrelated failures | Separated topic/queue and review data dependencies | Assurance availability does not depend on topic-index success |

## Independent checks

Legal reviewer sampled four existing authority/referral/litigation/rules files, then the actual new member guide, worker review contract and wheel/Senate text. Financial reviewer sampled five forensic/readiness/purpose/collection/staffing files. A separate issue researcher verified the Epstein enacted/proposed distinction and reviewed the actual new agenda. An interface worker implemented the member flow; a different code auditor challenged route safety, DOM handling, source URLs and the planning schema. The architect resolved identified issues. These are separately tasked AI contexts, not organizationally independent firms, licensed counsel signatories or source-authenticated human reviewers.

Read the detailed reports: [legal](legal-source-audit-2026-11-07.md), [financial](financial-source-audit-2026-11-07.md), [Epstein research](epstein-source-research-2026-11-07.md), [code](code-source-audit-2026-11-07.md). Their initial findings are preserved; this table records fixes rather than rewriting historical reports to appear flawless.

## Verification record and remaining gates

The local test suite, portable-skill validator, planning validator, review-byte validator and publication build supply structural/code evidence only. Browser checks exercise actual navigation, expandable topics, review scope and phone layout. Build and deployment results are recorded in the delivery receipt for this slice; completion of a command is not legal correctness or real-member usability acceptance.

Qualified counsel must still review actual congressional authority, proposed rule conformity, state-law elements, secrecy/immunity/privilege and any official dossier. Full action history for the new Epstein bills was not retrieved; introduced/referred is the latest verified stage, not a guaranteed live status. The official consultant handbook returned 403 during review. Unreviewed claims and later-law changes remain unresolved. A real member walkthrough and real iOS/Android installation qualification remain outstanding. Public sharing, a public GitHub repository, enrolled human reviewers and one completed public-source correction cycle remain MVP gates.

## Assumptions and effect ceiling

Only reviewed public methods and neutral questions are added. Risks are misleading authority, outdated law, re-identification of survivors, source poisoning and premature publication. Mitigations are explicit status labels, source dates, a non-exhaustive question agenda, no sensitive collection, non-executable retrieved content, exact-byte review records and human release control. No public backend/auth route is exposed, no sharing policy changed and no third-party message sent. Continue with static prototype work within this scope; stop if protected data or actual institutional process is introduced.
